notes: The Defect draft distinguishes mutable combat cost and freeToPlayOnce when retrieving discard instances. The printed 'cost 0' text is not a complete selector contract.
The red/colorless draft captures current Block at use and calculates target damage; Block is not consumed. Later same-play Block triggers do not contribute retroactively.
The Watcher draft describes one hit per counted non-dead/non-escaped monster, all against the selected target, not a single multiplied-damage hit.
The red/colorless draft describes the post-normal-draw hook as queuing draw before HP loss. Do not derive execution ordering solely from the printed card description.

discrepancies.wiki_description: At the start of your turn, lose 1 HP and draw 1 card.
discrepancies.local_research: The red/colorless draft, section 2 rare R64, states draw 1, then HP loss 1.
discrepancies.resolution: Both descriptions retained. The dataset does not qualify scheduler behavior or promote the draft's evidence grade.

notes: The Defect draft describes invoking the front Orb once without removal and then once with removal. Do not treat the phrase 'Evoke twice' as removing two different Orbs.
The red/colorless draft separates max-HP gain from the subsequent ordinary heal, which still goes through healing modifiers/prevention and caps. Current-HP gain is not unconditionally 3/4.
The Defect draft describes FTLAction inserting conditional draw at queue top and damage at queue bottom. Its turn-count predicate is evaluated at follow-up time.

discrepancies.wiki_description: Damage is described before conditional draw.
discrepancies.local_research: The Defect draft, section 4 FTL, states the follow-up inserts draw at top and damage at bottom, not damage-then-draw resolution.
discrepancies.resolution: Both descriptions retained. The dataset does not qualify scheduler behavior or promote the draft's evidence grade.

notes: The Watcher draft specifies base Block 3/4 and an additional 9/14 component in Wrath, for unmodified totals 12/18. Apply each component's calculation as qualified there, then one gain, rather than treating 9/14 as the total.
The Watcher draft identifies a HEALING tag used to exclude this card from healing-excluding generators, despite its printed payload upgrading a deck card rather than directly healing.
The Watcher draft treats Retain growth as instance-local combat Block. Upgrading after prior growth adds 2 Block and increases future growth by 1; it does not recalculate all historical growth.
The Silent draft distinguishes freeToPlayOnce from rewriting cost or costForTurn to zero. The grant checks positive mutable combat cost, not turn cost; X and unplayable sentinels do not receive it.
The Watcher draft counts hand instances other than the playing card, multiplies by 3/4, then applies Block modifiers once. Dexterity is not added once for every counted card.
The Watcher draft treats Retain growth as instance-local combat damage. Upgrading after prior growth adds 3 damage and increases future growth by 1, not a recalculation of prior Retain events.
